description: Authoritative performance byte budgets for the frontend bundle. This is the SINGLE source of truth for the numbers; rsbuild.config.ts, the Lighthouse configs, scripts/bundle-size-report.mjs and the make perf-budget target all read from here. The CLAUDE.md/agents.md tables are documentation MIRRORS of this file and must be updated with it. Satisfy a budget by reducing/splitting the bundle, never by raising a limit without rationale (see issue #117).

rationale.raw.maxInitialEntrypointBytes: Uncompressed size of the initial (eager) entrypoint, enforced by Rspack performance hints (hints: 'error') so a build that grows the eager bundle past this fails CI. Measured baseline ~388 KB; budget adds ~21% headroom for incremental growth while catching a doubling.
rationale.raw.maxAssetBytes: Uncompressed size ceiling for any single emitted JS/CSS asset (async route chunks included), enforced by Rspack performance hints. Measured largest chunk ~318 KB (the deferred auth/DI graph); budget adds ~26% headroom while catching a single page ballooning.
rationale.gzip.maxInitialEntrypointBytes: Transfer-size (gzip) ceiling for the eager entrypoint total, enforced by scripts/bundle-size-report.mjs (fails the bundle-size workflow when breached). Measured baseline ~125 KB; budget adds ~32% headroom.
rationale.gzip.maxAssetBytes: Transfer-size (gzip) ceiling for any single named/async JS chunk, enforced by scripts/bundle-size-report.mjs. Measured largest ~101 KB; budget adds ~29% headroom.
rationale.lighthouse.scriptSizeBytes: Lighthouse resource-summary:script:size (error). The production image serves with serve@14, which DOES gzip (it applies the compression middleware unless --no-compression), so Lighthouse transfer size is COMPRESSED, not raw. Measured against the running production container: / = 126 KB, /sign-up = 192 KB, /sign-in = 196 KB of script transfer. Budget is the heaviest page (~196 KB) plus ~35% headroom.
rationale.lighthouse.totalSizeBytes: Lighthouse resource-summary:total:size (error) — ceiling for total transferred bytes (script + document + fonts + images), compressed as above. Measured heaviest page /sign-in = 353 KB, of which ~156 KB is static woff2 fonts that do not grow. Budget adds ~36% headroom.
rationale.lighthouse.scriptCountWarn: Lighthouse resource-summary:script:count (warn) — flags request-count growth without failing CI, since request count varies with route-level splitting.

measuredBaseline.server: serve@14 with compression middleware enabled (responses are gzip; Content-Encoding: gzip verified against the running production container)
